mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO practice_record (user_id, question_id, is_correct, duration_sec, started_at, submitted_at, practice_date) VALUES
(#{r.userId}, #{r.questionId}, #{r.isCorrect}, #{r.durationSec}, #{r.startedAt}, #{r.submittedAt}, #{r.practiceDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_record SET is_correct = #{isCorrect}, duration_sec = #{durationSec}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND submitted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND practice_date = #{date} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND is_correct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(is_correct = 1 OR NULL) AS correct_count, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec)) AS avg_duration_sec FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND practice_date = #{date}
